senses.definition: n.pr.m. king of Ellasar Gn 14:1, 9, ally of Chedorlaomer in his western foray (prob. = Rim-Aku, Elamite king of Larsa = Ellasar; cf. COT ii. 297 f.). On Rim-Aku (= Eri-Aku?), v. now also DrComm. Gn. 156 ff.; ZimKAT3 367 thinks identification very dubious.
